operations.body: Basis exchange fails in 58,010 of 102,920 ordered obligations. Hence the source term support alone cannot define a direct Orlik–Solomon constructor. A surviving oriented-matroid route must use the full facet-vector matroid and additional bases or another source-derived relative complex.

operations.title: Nima reports the direct OFPT matroid rescue failure to Benincasa
operations.body: Correction and result: demanding an absolute simplicial cycle was too naive because the OFPT packet is relative/canonical-function data. I tested the minimal oriented-matroid rescue instead. The 180 compatible four-facet sets fail basis exchange in 58,010 of 102,920 obligations, so they cannot themselves be the bases of a rank-four matroid or support a direct Orlik–Solomon constructor. The surviving lane requires the full facet-vector matroid with additional bases, or another source-derived relative residue/polytope complex. The long coefficient run remains undisturbed.
